PostSummary.title: PostSummary

QuickReplyOut.title: QuickReplyOut

get.description: The current user, provisioned on first sight (TR-AUTH-03), with their workspaces.
Also remembers this workspace as the user's last one, for /app (F-02).

post.description:
Mark an auto reply "should not have sent" ("bad"), or clear the mark (null). Only a
decision that sent a reply takes feedback (409 otherwise).

get.description: FR-KB-04, FR-SUG-05, FR-SUG-06: brand voice, takeover period and escalation phrases.
Every matching automation (no paging); ``q`` searches names and keywords.

post.description: A draft, blank or filled from a template (FR-AUT-12).
Bulk pause from the list (FR-AUT-19).

put.description: The account's automations in their new order (FR-AUT-15).

Replace the whole definition (autosave). Returns overlaps and what activation still needs.
An active automation must stay complete: 422 lists what the change would break.

post.description:
Validate (FR-AUT-02) and entitlements; 422 lists every missing or invalid field. Resuming
an automation that held private replies restarts its account's queue (FR-AUT-10).
A draft copy named "… (copy)".

get.description: Figures and the daily series for the last 7 or 30 days (FR-AUT-16).

post.description: What would happen for this text; sends nothing.

get.description:
Plan, status, entitlements, usage (AI credits, knowledge characters) and trial
eligibility (TR-BIL-05). Prices are empty until P8.

patch.description:
Archive or unarchive; set or clear the conversation's AI mode override (auto needs a paid
plan: 402 entitlement_required); resume_ai ends a takeover pause (FR-SUG-05).

get.description: Newest first; next_cursor loads older messages (upward infinite scroll).

post.description:
Queue a reply; it is sent by the worker and progress arrives as message.updated events.

Any member may reply. The same Idempotency-Key with the same body returns the first response
and sends nothing more; with a different body it is 409 idempotency_conflict.

get.description: The conversation's pending (scheduled or sending) messages, soonest first.

post.description:
send_at must be at least 2 minutes away and 5 minutes before the reply window closes.

With an Idempotency-Key (TR-API-05), repeating the request returns the first response and
schedules nothing more; the same key with a different body is 409 idempotency_conflict.

F-08 Regenerate: up to 5 per message; suggestion.created carries the result. 409 when
the conversation's AI mode is off, there is no customer message, or the 5 are used; 402
quota_exceeded when AI credits are used up.

FR-AI-03 on request; conversation.updated carries the new summary (its ``summary`` key).
402 quota_exceeded without credits; 409 when AI analysis is off for the account.
Connect a fake Instagram account for local development.
Inject a fake DM or comment. It goes through the same intake as a real webhook.

get.description:
Gaps asked in the last 30 days, most asked first, with up to three example messages
(FR-KB-06, TR-AI-12).

post.description: Hidden until a customer asks again (FR-KB-06); 409 conflict once answered.

get.description: Every source, newest first, with characters used of the plan's knowledge_characters.

post.description:
FR-KB-01: an FAQ (question, body), note (title, body), web page (url) or file
(file_asset_id). 422 lists missing or foreign fields; 402 quota_exceeded over
knowledge_characters; 415 for a file that isn't PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD up to 10 MB; 404 for a
gap_id that isn't this workspace's. Ingestion runs in the background (status pending).

patch.description: Any change (or ``reingest``) adds 1 to the version and ingests the source again.

post.description:
FR-KB-03: the answer a suggestion would draft, with its sources, or can_answer false
("Not in your knowledge"). 1 credit; nothing is stored or sent. 402 quota_exceeded without
credits; 503 when the AI is unavailable.

Register an uploaded file: it must be in this workspace's folder (else 422 on public_id)
and within the limits (else 415 unsupported_media). Registering it again returns it.
Parameters for uploading one file from the browser into ws/{workspace_id}/{purpose}.

patch.description:
FR-AI-04: change a message's intent or sentiment. The answer shows the corrected values
with ``corrected: true``; the conversation's chips follow a correction of its latest
analysis (conversation.updated).

get.description:
The latest decision for an inbound message, or the one that sent this AI message
(FR-SUG-04: the "Sent by AI" popover and the escalation banner). 404 when there is none.

post.description:
Send a failed message again (the same row). A message already queued or sending is
returned as it is, so a second click never sends it twice.

get.description: Newest first; ``q`` searches captions. Stories are left out (they take no comments).
The Scheduled tab: pending first by send time, then recent sent, failed and expired.

delete.description: Cancel while the message is still scheduled (409 conflict after that).

patch.description: Edit the text or time while the message is still scheduled (409 conflict after that).

post.description:
Finish Embedded Signup: store the number and subscribe to its webhooks. 409
account_in_use when the number is connected to another workspace.
Retry the webhook subscription after it failed (F-03 edge case).

get.description: Approved message templates for the template picker (sends outside the 24 h window).

post.description:
F-08 Dismiss: a pending suggestion becomes dismissed (suggestion.updated); any other is
returned as it is.
